role: The landing authority: the scripts and programs that decide whether a change may reach main.

invariants.statement: No script in this package may invoke git or gh with a gate-bypass flag (--no-verify, --admin, --force).
invariants.why: This package IS the gate. A bypass flag used from inside it does not skip a check for one commit, it removes the check for everyone, silently and permanently. Documenting the flag is fine and stays legal; running it is not, which is why the pattern matches a command position and not a mention.

counterexample.proves: --admin is caught, including behind a pipe

invariants.statement: Every non-test Python module in this package opens with a module docstring.
invariants.why: A gate whose contract is not written at the top of the file gets re-derived from its code by the next reader, and re-derived wrong. Every module here already carries one; the rule keeps that from eroding one hurried file at a time.
